summary: The PR addresses the issue of multiple URLResolver constructions by modifying get_resolver to use settings.ROOT_URLCONF before the memoized function call. The change is well-intentioned and passes all tests.

issues.description: The new function _get_resolver is introduced but not documented. Adding a docstring for _get_resolver would improve maintainability.
The reproduction script and test script print statements instead of using proper assertions or logging. This makes them less useful for automated testing and debugging.
